subject: Delayed order delivery
body: My order is late and the tracking page has not updated. Please confirm the delivery date.

subject: Package not delivered
body: The package was due yesterday but has not arrived. Tracking still shows it in transit.

subject: Delivery status request
body: I still have not received my order. Could you check the shipment and expected delivery date?

subject: Unexpected charge
body: I see an extra charge on my invoice. Please explain the billing amount and issue a refund if it is incorrect.

subject: Refund for returned item
body: I returned the item last week but have not received my refund. Please check the payment status.

subject: Invoice correction
body: The invoice includes a duplicate charge. Please correct the billing statement and confirm the refund.

subject: Unable to sign in
body: I cannot log in to my account after resetting my password. The verification code never arrives.

subject: Account access help
body: My account is locked and the password reset email has not arrived. Please help me sign in.

subject: Missing shipment update
body: The delivery tracking has not changed for three days. Please locate the package and update me.

subject: Refund follow-up
body: I am following up on my refund for the returned product. The payment has not appeared in my account.

subject: Order arrived damaged
body: The package arrived late and the product is damaged. Please arrange a replacement and advise on return shipping.

subject: Billing payment question
body: I paid the invoice twice by mistake. Please review the payment and refund the duplicate billing charge.
